Support for Regulatory Reforms for Competitiveness Program

description.narrative: El objetivo general de desarrollo es mejorar el ambiente de negocios para contribuir al incremento de la competitividad del pas a travs de los siguientes objetivos especficos de desarrollo: (i) reducir los costos de cumplimiento regulatorio de empresas con el Estado; (ii) reducir la participacin de empresas pblicas nacionales en la economa; y (iii) incrementar la eficiencia de las operaciones de comercio exterior.

The general development objective of this operation is to improve the business environment to contribute to increasing the country's competitiveness through the following specific development objectives: (i) reducing the regulatory compliance costs of companies with the State; (ii) reducing the participation of national public companies in the economy; and (iii) increasing the efficiency of foreign trade operations.
